evidence.text: GET /api/local-agents/tools/next calls toolGatewayService.claimNext. POST /api/local-agents/tools/{requestId}/response calls toolGatewayService.complete.
LocalAgentToolGatewayService.claimNext calls repository.claimNext. LocalAgentToolGatewayService.complete validates and enriches the response before calling repository.complete.
LocalAgentToolExecutionRepository.claimNext claims a queued request. LocalAgentToolExecutionRepository.complete stores the terminal response fields.
